meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将复杂目标拆解成有依据的步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对复杂目标不知如何拆分
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex goals into evidence-based steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to break down complex goals

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把大目标拆成细小的步骤，每步都记录完成证据，通过人工质控和检查点推进长任务；证据必须来自真实运行结果，不靠测试自证，并在需要时派出子代理并行干活。
howto.when: 当你说出“ulw-loop”“ulw”等关键词，或要求进行证据驱动、带人工质控和检查点的长期目标执行时，该技能会接管。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 模式开始这个项目，按照流程执行。
say.note: Claude 会先读取工作流并注册目标。

say.text: 把这个长期任务拆成带检查点的步骤，每步记录证据。
say.note: Claude 会创建细粒度计划并逐项推进。

say.text: 用证据驱动的方式完成 X 任务，带人工质控。
say.note: Claude 会委派子代理并核对真实表面证据。

howto.what_en: Claude decomposes a goal into tiny steps, records evidence for each, and advances long work via manual QA and checkpoints. Evidence must come from real surfaces (CLI, HTTP, browser). Claude may spawn subagents for parallel work.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “ulw-loop”, “ulw”, or ask for evidence-driven, manually-QA'd, checkpointed long-term goal execution.

say_en.text: Start this project using ulw-loop mode and follow the workflow.
say_en.note: Claude reads the workflow and registers the goal first.

say_en.text: Break this long task into checkpointed steps and record evidence for each.
say_en.note: Claude creates a granular plan and tracks each step.

say_en.text: Execute task X with evidence-driven approach and manual QA.
say_en.note: Claude delegates work and verifies real-surface evidence.
